title: EggCooking
description: More egg types and egg cooking!
body:
# What is this plugin for?
More creatures can lay eggs, such as rabbits and parrots (yes, I only added these two), and all eggs can be roasted and eaten over a campfire!
## Features
Bake these eggs! All eggs can be baked!
Each egg has a different satiety and effect!
like:
Eggs have a Slow Falling.
Rabbit eggs have a Jump Boost.
And more!
